about: Ordinary work that names a withdrawn value ($49, corrected to $29) without writing it back, from an independent review of 2026-11-21 (22 operations). `exit` is the guard's exit code: 2 blocked, 0 passed. `why` names the review finding: G-1 is the line rule (old value on a line without the new one is blocked; a decision, kept), G-2 is a command that removes or only reads the old value (must pass).

cases.name: prose wrapped at 80 columns

tool_input.content:
We lowered the Pro plan in March. It used to cost $49
a month and now costs $29 a month.

cases.name: changelog, Changed/Removed sections

tool_input.content:
## 1.4.0
### Changed
- Pro is now $29 a month.
### Removed
- The $49 price point.

cases.name: before/after code blocks
diff block in Markdown
two-row table (old row, new row)
test that the old value is gone
redirect map
Edit that removes it: old_string has it, new_string does not
Edit keeping a history line untouched in context
sed -i that replaces old with new
sed -i that deletes the old line (address has ' a ')
sed -i delete by address
sed -i insert a note (i\) naming old and new on two lines

tool_input.command:
sed -i '1i\
Price changed from $49\
to $29.' docs/pricing.md

cases.name: perl one-liner that prints, with a module (-Mstrict), no -i
perl -ne grep for the old value
python -c that replaces old with new, one statement per line

tool_input.command:
python3 -c "
old = '\$49'
new = '\$29'
s = open('docs/pricing.md').read()
open('docs/pricing.md', 'w').write(s.replace(old, new))
"

cases.name: python -c replace on one line
node -e that checks for the old value and writes a marker file
commit message in a heredoc file

tool_input.command:
cat <<'EOF' > /tmp/msg.txt
Remove the $49 price

Pro is $29 since March.
EOF

cases.name: grep for the old value into a report
echo a note to a log

tool_input.command: echo 'checked: no $49 left in docs' >> notes.log

cases.name: heredoc test file
